notes:
After presenting SPL Reference at the Hi-Fidelity show in Milan, there was one more opportunity to put the app to work: the flight home to London.

This measurement captures takeoff from inside the aircraft cabin, from the acceleration along the runway through lift-off and the initial climb. Engine thrust, aerodynamic noise and vibration combine to create one of the most energetic acoustic phases of a flight.

The interesting question is the comparison: how much louder is takeoff than the steady noise we experience during cruise? We tend to notice the drama of takeoff, but a shorter, louder event and several hours of continuous cabin noise represent very different kinds of sound exposure.

A fitting final measurement for the Milan trip: using the same app presented to the Hi-Fi community to measure the journey home.

Environment: Aircraft cabin
Journey: Milan → London
Event: Takeoff and initial climb
Measurement type: Transport / personal sound exposure

measurement.title: From Milan to London — How Loud Is Takeoff?
